Add an entry for each item the business cleans: copy the lines from "## CS-01" down, paste them below the

after its number.
Frequency is how often the item is cleaned: one of After use; Every shift; Daily; Weekly; Other.
For Other, write how often in Other-frequency, in your own words; for any other Frequency, leave
Other-frequency empty.
Precautions is anything to take care over while cleaning the item. Method is how the item is cleaned,
with any chemicals and equipment it is cleaned with.
An entry needs Frequency and Method before it can be proposed or confirmed, and Other-frequency too when
Frequency is Other.
If the business keeps its cleaning schedule somewhere else, write where in Where, under Kept elsewhere.

both are printed.
To carry a value on to more lines, start each extra line with two spaces, straight after the line before
it, with no blank line between.
State says where an entry, or Kept elsewhere, stands: unanswered (it may hold what has been given so far; By and On stay empty);
proposed (taken from a file, or given without a name, and not yet agreed by a named person at the business: say where it came from in Source);
or confirmed (given or agreed by a named person at the business: put their name in By and the date, as YYYY-MM-DD, in On).
Only a confirmed entry, or a confirmed Kept elsewhere, goes into your documents. An entry that is not
confirmed, and a Kept elsewhere that holds anything and is not confirmed, are named there as not yet confirmed.

## CS-01 Meat slicer

Frequency: After use
Other-frequency:
Precautions: Unplug it before taking it apart, and keep fingers clear of the blade.
Method: Take off the guard and the carriage, wash them in the sink with the kitchen detergent, and rinse them.
  Spray every part with the sanitiser, wipe it with blue roll, and put the slicer back together once it is dry.
State: confirmed
By: Priya Shah
On: 2026-11-17
Source:

## CS-02 Coffee machine

Frequency: Daily
Other-frequency:
Precautions: Let it cool down before cleaning the group heads.
Method: Run its cleaning programme with a cleaning tablet, soak the drip tray and the filter baskets in the sink, and wipe the outside with a damp cloth.
State: confirmed
By: Sam Okafor
On: 2026-11-17
Source:

## CS-03 Drinks fridge

Frequency: Other
Other-frequency: On the first Monday of each month
Precautions: Switch it off at the wall first.
Method: Move the drinks into the other fridges, wipe out the inside with warm soapy water and then the sanitiser, and dry it with blue roll before switching it back on.
State: confirmed
By: Sam Okafor
On: 2026-11-17
Source:

## CS-04 Floor behind the counter

Frequency: Every shift
Other-frequency:
Precautions:
Method: Sweep, then mop with the floor cleaner, using the red mop and bucket kept for the kitchen floor.
State: proposed
By:
On:
Source: Tom Reid's notes from the kitchen walk-round
